_comment: MCP Bridge configuration for connecting Copilot CLI to OpenAI Codex CLI
name: codex-bridge
description: Bridge to OpenAI Codex CLI for fast code generation powered by GPT-5. Use for rapid implementation, boilerplate generation, and multi-file scaffolding.

tools.name: codex_generate
tools.description: Generate code using Codex CLI. Best for fast implementation of well-defined tasks.

prompt.description: Description of the code to generate

language.description: Target programming language (typescript, python, go, etc.)

tools.name: codex_edit
tools.description: Edit existing files using Codex CLI. Provide file path and change description.

filePath.description: Path to the file to edit

instruction.description: Description of the changes to make

approvalMode.description: Level of autonomy for applying changes

tools.name: codex_explain
tools.description: Explain code using Codex CLI. Get detailed explanations of code logic.

filePath.description: Path to the file to explain

registration.projectLevel: Add to .mcp.json (or .github/mcp.json) in the repository under mcpServers
